visual_overrides.core_identity: A severed troll arm still animated by regeneration, crawling as a grotesque hand-creature without graphic gore.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Long muscular forearm ending in an oversized clawed hand with fingers acting like legs.
visual_overrides.head_features: No head; identity comes from troll skin, long proportions, and the oversized clawed hand.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Single elongated arm with large hand, bent wrist, and finger-walking posture.
visual_overrides.surface: Tough troll skin with sparse bumps; severed end simplified and non-gory.

scene_overrides.natural_posture: The severed forearm is fully supported by its clawed fingers and hand as it crawls; no unsupported floating limb.
